Optional: self-host the Supabase library (recommended for privacy).

Download this file and save it here as supabase.js:
  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.45.4/dist/umd/supabase.js

If this folder has no supabase.js, the site loads that same pinned file from jsDelivr instead.
Once you self-host, you can remove https://cdn.jsdelivr.net from the Content-Security-Policy in _headers.
